notes.title: Magic Exposure slated for December 9!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40623881/16d028370ebd061edad380b110b9060d169ef3e5.png[/img]

We're so delighted to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/Magic_Exposure__Yuri_Visual_Novel/]Magic Exposure[/url] will be released on December 9th! Check out its presentation trailer and wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599700/Magic_Exposure__Yuri_Visual_Novel/

https://youtu.be/trpKTL3f7hc
Also, you may have noticed we made some updates to the original proposal. Since this is a product that doesn't fit our main audience and the artist who designed the original characters hadn't been working with us anymore, we made new concepts art based on what we had and transformed Magic into a cute kinect story instead of a traditional novel with a few routes. The price will be according to the new proposal and we'll keep some translations like Japanese, Simplified Chinese, etc.

We hope you enjoy it as well you enjoy our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll/list/62178]upcoming releases[/url].
